CacheEdit.description:
A single cache edit operation sent in the `cache_edits` content block.
Currently only supports `delete_tool_result`.

oneOf.description: Runs immediately, no model turn.
Expands a skill body and goes on to the model.

project_root.description: Absent and `null` both mean the scene with no project.

ConfigGetProviderParams.description:
The `(scene, project_root)` pair a configuration method acts on. Omitted
means this daemon's own; a named `project_root` reaches another project
the daemon serves. `null` is refused: these methods act on the *project*
tier, and a session with no project has none.

ConfigSetProviderParams.description:
The `(scene, project_root)` pair a configuration method acts on. Omitted
means this daemon's own; a named `project_root` reaches another project
the daemon serves. `null` is refused: these methods act on the *project*
tier, and a session with no project has none.

config.description: A partial patch merged key by key onto the project tier's entry.

delete.description: Remove the provider instead of merging.

task_models.description: A partial patch merged key by key.

ConfigTarget.description:
The `(scene, project_root)` pair a configuration method acts on. Omitted
means this daemon's own; a named `project_root` reaches another project
the daemon serves. `null` is refused: these methods act on the *project*
tier, and a session with no project has none.

managed.description: The deployment's managed layer; only `effective` has one.

settings.description:
The tier's settings file as it sits on disk (`null` when it has none),
or the merged result for `effective`.

ContentBlock.description:
内容块。`type` 字段做 enum tag。

字段名 / 取值与 Anthropic API 一致；外部 JSON 直传可读。

content.description: 可以是 string 或 array of ContentBlock；用 ToolResultContent 区分

provider.description:
Which provider produced it. Transcript-only: request builders
always leave it `None`, so it never reaches a provider's wire.

oneOf.description:
Anthropic `cache_edits` content block: requests server-side deletion of
cached tool result content by tool_use_id. Only meaningful in the request;
never returned by the API. Requires the `context-management-2025-06-27`
beta header.

created_ms.description: Unix millis when the job was created

durable.description: true = persisted to disk and survives restarts

expires_ms.description: Unix millis after which the job's next fire is its last. `None`: never.

last_fired_ms.description: Unix millis of last fire (prevents double-fire within the same minute)

recurring.description: true = fire on each cron match; false = fire once then auto-delete

session_id.description: The session the job's prompt is sent to when it fires.

parent_session_id.description: Set on a sidechain deleted along with its parent.

DoctorReport.description:
What `daemon.doctor` answers. `settings_tiers`, `providers`, `hooks` and
`health` are the checks' own `details`, whose shape each check decides.

namespaces.description: Only these namespaces; all of the host's when omitted.

EntryView.description:
An extension entry as `session.entries` lists it and `session.appendEntry`
answers.

at.description: Messages before this entry, in `session.history`'s coordinates.

oneOf.description: The old engine of an in-place rebuild did not stop in time.

path.description: Absolute, on the daemon's machine; must not exist yet.

cut_at.description: The moment the snapshot was cut, RFC 3339.

format_version.description: The archive format's version, as in `manifest.json`.

GoalView.description:
A goal as hosts and the model see it: the goal, and whether automatic
rounds are armed.

rounds_since_armed.description:
Rounds started since the goal was last armed; what the blocked lower
bound counts.

HistoryItem.description: One projected message, plus where it sits and where it came from.

oneOf.description: UI-only：本地命令输出、提醒、通知。**不**进 API。

origin.description: `null` on lines written before origins were recorded.

usage.description: The model call's usage, on an assistant message.

HistoryOrigin.description: Where a history item came from.

oneOf.description: Typed by the person.
Sent by the person while a turn was running.
The expansion of a slash command.

Put there by the engine or a tool: reminders, recalled memory, a
skill's instructions.
A compaction's summary or kept history.

active.description: Whether the session is in memory; a step in flight is not visible yet.

total.description: Projected messages in the whole transcript.

limit.description: Clamped to 500 rather than refused; 100 when omitted.

ImportRunParams.description:
The `(scene, project_root)` pair a configuration method acts on. Omitted
means this daemon's own; a named `project_root` reaches another project
the daemon serves. `null` is refused: these methods act on the *project*
tier, and a session with no project has none.

source.description: One of the `source` values `import.list` returned for the same project.

Initiator.description:
Who asked for a turn. A client's turn crosses no scene boundary; the
daemon's own turns go to sessions it already serves.

config.description: An `McpServerConfig`, tagged by `type`; the pool validates it.

McpServerRef.description: A sign-in flow that was cancelled, or a server that was signed out of.

oneOf.description:
Connected once and the connection has since dropped; the next request
reconnects.
The remote server wants an OAuth sign-in (`mcp.auth.start`).
The MCP policy refuses it.
A server the project declares, in a project that is not trusted.

McpServerWritten.description: What `mcp.addServer` / `mcp.updateServer` wrote and what is connected now.

secrets_written_to.description:
Set when `headers` or `env` went to the `settings.local.json` beside
`written_to`.

PluginDisclosure.description:
What a plugin will put into the model's context and start, shown before
anyone depends on it.

script_faults.description: `[[script]]` bindings that could not be honoured, each with its reason.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the archive, hex. Required for `http(s)://`.

name.description:
A cache directory name: 1 to 128 of ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_`,
`-`, `+`, not starting with `.`.

enabled.description: Whether it is enabled once installed (`plugins.enable_on_install`).

PluginScope.description: Which tier's plugin directory a request acts on.

oneOf.description: Under the global root, shared by every scene.
Under the scene root, for this daemon's scene only.

matched.description:

default decided.

requires_trust.description: What the project sets that takes effect only while it is trusted.

router_rebuilt.description: A usable router was actually built; `ok` can hold without it.

id.description: Request id; we echo back. Number or string. None = notification.

params.description: Method-specific params (object or null)

settings.description: The merged settings a session here would resolve to.

errors.description: Scenes that did not load, each with the reason.

SceneSource.description: A `scene.json`, as an object or as its JSON text.

sessions.description: Sessions in memory recorded under this scene.

allowed.description: `null` is no whitelist: every registered tool.

cron.description: Five fields, M H DoM Mon DoW, in UTC.

recurring.description: `false`: run once at the next match, then delete.

from the pool.

provider.description: Refused when given: a sub-agent runs on its parent's provider.

StopReason.description: 模型停止原因。Anthropic API 取值。

oneOf.description:
+**: agent hit `EngineConfig.max_api_calls_per_turn`. Not from
the Anthropic API — emitted by our engine when the configured per-
turn budget is exhausted. Caller (e.g. `AgentTool` for sub-agents)
should handle gracefully: return whatever partial work exists,
flagged but **not** is_error=true. Carries the same
`max_turns_reached` attachment + early-return semantics.
